newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel announces further easing of closure.
newsitem.headline: Israel announces further easing of closure.

text.p: Israel said on Wednesday it would allow another 4,000 Palestinian labourers to enter the Jewish state to work.
But PLO officials said 10,000 labourers who Israel said would be permitted in beginning on Wednesday had yet to be allowed entry.

"The Israelis have informed us that they will allow 10,000 workers from Gaza to go to work. But it takes time to issue entry permits," said Said al-Mudallal, director of employment at the Palestinian Ministry of Labour. He said he did not expect any workers to enter before Friday.
Late on Wednesday night, an Israeli army spokeswoman said another 4,000 workers from the Gaza Strip and West Bank would be allowed in, raising the number to 14,000.
She also said 150 traders would be permitted into Israel and that lorries from Gaza bearing goods would be allowed in under Israeli security escort after passing security checks.

Israel imposed the closure in March after Islamic militant suicide bombers killed 59 people in Israel in four attacks. It gradually eased the ban but tightened it last month when clashes erupted over a second entrance Israel opened to a tourist tunnel near a Moslem holy site in Jerusalem.
